name: change_world
description: Apply one settled world change to match the story. Set `verb` to pick the change and fill that verb's own fields. One call makes one change.

JoinParty.description: A character here starts travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who is joining.
Exact id of an npc here.

LeaveParty.description: A companion stops travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the companion leaving.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item here or carried.

to.description: Exact id of the player, an npc here, or this place.

Rest.description: Spend the night in a safe spot to heal the player's and the party's Health to full.

entity_id.description: Exact id of something hidden here: an npc or an item.

UnlockWay.description: Open a locked way once the story has dealt with it.

to_id.description: Exact id of the locked way's destination.

change.description: The one world change to apply; `verb` picks the change.

name: move
description: Move through an unlocked way from the player's current place.

to_id.description: Exact id of the place to move to.

with_ids.description: Exact ids of living NPCs here who come along.

name: roll
description: Roll 2d6 plus an ability and helpful items against a Difficulty Score or an npc; `actor_id` when a hired member acts instead of the player.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player may read; it heads the card.

ability.description: Which ability the action calls on.

items.description: Exact ids of items the actor carries that plainly help; +1 each.

difficulty.description: Difficulty Score; the SRD's guidelines: 8 easy, 10 moderate, 12 hard. Null when `against` names an NPC.

against.description: Exact id of an npc here; its Health is the Difficulty Score.

dangerous.description: A fight, a trap, a fall: the margin becomes damage, to the NPC on a hit or to the actor on a miss.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

name: level_up
description: Raise one ability and either Health or Inventory Score by 1, once, at the adventure's end: the player first, then each hired member in turn.

ability.description: Which ability to raise by 1; null asks the player.

boost.description: Health or Inventory to raise by 1; null asks the player.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

name: hire
description: The player hires someone here to work: the worldsmith writes their sheet once this turn ends, and they join the party. Someone already travelling with the player may be hired too; a sheet is for someone hired to work, never for one who merely comes along.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who here signs on; they must not already carry a sheet.

terms.description: What they are hired for and on what terms, as agreed, for the worldsmith.
